text: For a Fabry-Pérot resonator with mirror (power) reflectivity R, how does the finesse depend on R?
choices: F = π√R/(1−R); higher R gives higher finesse and narrower resonance peaks
F = (1−R)/(π√R); higher R gives lower finesse
F = πR/(1+R); finesse is independent of R
F = c/(2nL); the finesse equals the free spectral range
explanation: The finesse is F = π√R/(1−R), so as R → 1 the finesse diverges and the resonance peaks narrow (more round trips, longer photon lifetime). Choice 1 inverts the dependence, choice 2 has the wrong form, and choice 3 confuses finesse with the free spectral range c/(2n_gL).
